note.zh: 原主表 27/42 行满样本，14 行独立延时补测，1 行原配方容量 hold 后采用新配方；42 行覆盖不等于原配方全部通过。未做任务精度评测。
note.en: The original matrix had 27/42 full-sample rows, 14 separately extended retests, and one capacity hold completed using a new configuration. Coverage does not mean all points passed on the original configuration. Task accuracy was not assessed.

notes.zh: 上述固定输出为冷输入压力测试。原配方 C16 长上下文容量受限，混合媒体配置启动失败；近 1M 仅验证 stock 备用算子。
notes.en: These fixed-output points use cold-input stress traffic. Original-configuration C16 long-context capacity was held, the mixed-media configuration failed to start, and near-1M used the stock fallback operator.
